proof_contract: Derive fixed-count inclusion moments, unbiased difference in means and exact variance S1²/n1+S0²/n0−S_tau²/N; show unbiased sample arm variances by finite pair-difference identity. Expected Neyman conservatism is not pointwise dominance or finite coverage. Do not inherit the unproved finite-population CLT in source; normal power uses its separate explicitly known-Gaussian contract.

Prove finite Fisher sharp-null inclusive weighted-rank validity including ties. Constant-shift test inversion has coverage for that sharp constant effect, not an arbitrary heterogeneous ATE. Enumerate power using actual alternative potential outcomes and the same stated test. Provide an analytic exact inversion argument, not a finite parameter grid.

Independent stratified assignment gives weighted-stratum estimand/variance. Explicit treatment counts and independent assignment units; precision comparison is for the stipulated population, not universal stratification superiority. Cluster assignment requires cluster-level information and a specified target/weight.

Known independent-Gaussian arms: derive exact two-tailed power and optimal continuous variance allocation, integer floor/ceil choice and minimum sample size evidence. Label known variance and stipulated effect. If explaining cluster power, derive variance from independent Gaussian common/idiosyncratic shocks, distinguish variance and standard-error multipliers.

Compliance: define assignment ITT even without exclusion; LATE adds c03 assumptions. Derive random-arm mean influences and covariance-aware ratio influence with nonzero first stage; exceptional empty arm samples vanish under positive fixed assignment probability. Do not equate this iid-superpopulation variance with the finite-population design variance.

Interference: correctly specified known exposure mapping, positive marginal assignment-exposure probabilities, HT unbiasedness and joint-inclusion covariance. Full synthetic table allows exact variance; observed data need not identify every variance term when joint probabilities vanish.

Attrition: observed response rates/means plus bounded outcomes give sharp population identification interval, with explicit observationally equivalent endpoint constructions. Equal response rates do not imply MAR or zero selection bias; identification bounds are not confidence intervals.
